SWS DIAGNOSIS
TSB Revision
SIMPLIFIED WIRING SYSTEM (SWS)
54B-71
STEP 1. Check the sunroof motor assembly power supply 
circuit (battery) at the sunroof motor assembly connector 
D-06 by back probing.
(1) Do not disconnect the sunroof motor assembly connector 
D-06.
(2) Measure the voltage between terminal 3 and ground by 
back probing.
Q: Is the voltage approximately 12 volts (battery positive 
voltage)?
YES : Go to Step 4.
NO : Go to Step 2.
STEP 2. Check sunroof motor assembly connector D-06 
for damage.
Q: Is sunroof motor assembly connector D-06 in good 
condition?
YES : Go to Step 3.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 8W1, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The sunroof should 
work normally.
